senses.en: to have a strong desire for something

example.en: After years abroad, she hankered for home cooking.
example.zh: 在国外多年后，她渴望吃家乡菜。

senses.en: relating to or affected by sudden involuntary muscle contractions

example.en: He made a spasmodic movement with his arm.
example.zh: 他的手臂抽搐了一下。

senses.en: happening in short irregular bursts

example.en: Progress on the project has been spasmodic.
example.zh: 这个项目的进展时断时续。

senses.en: a spread made from vegetable oils, used instead of butter

example.en: She spread margarine on her toast instead of butter.
example.zh: 她在吐司上涂了人造黄油，而不是黄油。

senses.en: a memory of something past; the act of remembering

example.en: She kept the photo in remembrance of her grandmother.
example.zh: 她保留那张照片以纪念她的祖母。

senses.en: a small object kept to remind one of a person or event

example.en: He gave each guest a small remembrance of the wedding.
example.zh: 他送给每位客人一份婚礼小纪念品。

senses.en: floating on water; not sinking

example.en: The boat stayed afloat despite the rough waves.
example.zh: 尽管风浪很大，小船仍然漂浮着。

senses.en: surviving financially or staying in business

example.en: The small shop is struggling to stay afloat.
example.zh: 这家小店铺在勉强维持经营。

senses.en: a public event where cowboys show skills like riding horses and cattle

example.en: Thousands of fans attended the annual rodeo.
example.zh: 成千上万的观众观看了年度牛仔竞技表演。

senses.en: to change something so it works for a new purpose or situation

example.en: The engineers adapted the design for use in cold weather.
example.zh: 工程师们调整了设计，使其适合在寒冷天气中使用。

senses.en: to change your behavior or become used to new conditions

example.en: Children often adapt quickly to a new school.
example.zh: 孩子们通常很快适应新学校。

senses.en: the condition or period of carrying a developing baby before birth

example.en: The pregnancy lasted about nine months.
example.zh: 这次怀孕持续了大约九个月。

senses.en: once every year; every year

example.en: The festival is held annually in May.
example.zh: 这个节庆活动每年五月举行。

senses.en: inside the limits of a place, time, or range

example.en: Please reply within three days.
example.zh: 请在三天内回复。

senses.en: inside a place or container

example.en: The old house looks plain from the street, but within, it is warm and bright.
example.zh: 这栋老房子从街上看起来朴素，但里面温暖明亮。

senses.en: to make air, water, or soil dirty or harmful

example.en: Factories that dump waste into rivers pollute the water.
example.zh: 把废水排入河流的工厂会污染水源。

senses.en: not legally or logically valid; not acceptable

example.en: Your ticket is invalid after the expiry date.
example.zh: 你的票过了有效期就无效了。

senses.en: a person made weak or disabled by illness or injury

example.en: He has been an invalid since the accident.
example.zh: 那次事故后他一直是个病人。

senses.en: to force someone to leave a job or service because of illness or injury

example.en: The soldier was invalided out of the army.
example.zh: 这名士兵因病退役了。

senses.en: feeling ashamed or uncomfortable in a social situation

example.en: She was embarrassed when she forgot his name.
example.zh: 她忘记了他的名字，感到很尴尬。

senses.en: happening soon

example.en: He is busy preparing for the upcoming exams.
example.zh: 他正忙着准备即将到来的考试。

senses.en: unable to think clearly or understand something

example.en: I was confused by the complicated instructions.
example.zh: 我被复杂的说明弄糊涂了。

senses.en: disordered or mixed up; not clearly organized

example.en: The report gave a confused account of what happened.
example.zh: 这份报告对事情的描述杂乱不清。

senses.en: the quality of treating people equally and following rules

example.en: Students appreciated the fairness of the grading system.
example.zh: 学生们赞赏这套评分制度的公平性。

senses.en: the number zero; nothing

example.en: The temperature dropped to nought degrees overnight.
example.zh: 气温一夜之间降到了零度。

senses.en: used in 'according to' to mean as stated by, or in agreement with

example.en: According to the news, the train will arrive late.
example.zh: 根据新闻，火车将晚点到达。

senses.en: the middle point or part of something

example.en: There is a fountain in the center of the park.
example.zh: 公园中央有一个喷泉。

senses.en: to focus or concentrate something on a main point or subject

example.en: The discussion centered on the new project.
example.zh: 讨论集中在新项目上。

senses.en: a building or place where a particular activity happens

example.en: She works at a community center.
example.zh: 她在社区中心工作。

senses.en: a game in which two or four players hit a ball over a net with rackets

example.en: She plays tennis with her friends every weekend.
example.zh: 她每个周末都和朋友们打网球。

senses.en: a period when a machine or system is not operating, especially due to faults

example.en: The system upgrade reduced server downtime significantly.
example.zh: 系统升级大大减少了服务器停机时间。

senses.en: a quick involuntary spasm of the diaphragm making a sharp sound; often plural

example.en: She drank some water to stop her hiccups.
example.zh: 她喝了点水来止住打嗝。

senses.en: to make hiccup sounds

example.en: The baby hiccupped after feeding.
example.zh: 婴儿喂奶后打起嗝来。

senses.en: straps worn over the shoulders to hold up trousers (US term)
senses.zh: 吊裤带；背带（美式，英式为 braces）

example.en: He wore gray suspenders with his suit.
example.zh: 他穿着西装，配灰色吊裤带。

senses.en: a person who breeds or grows animals or plants, or who raises money or bids

example.en: The cattle raiser sold his herd at the autumn market.
example.zh: 养牛人在秋季集市上卖掉了牛群。

senses.en: to poke or push something with a quick, sharp movement

example.en: He jabbed his finger at the map.
example.zh: 他用手指猛戳地图。

senses.en: a quick, short punch, especially in boxing

example.en: She landed a quick jab to her opponent's face.
example.zh: 她一记快速的刺拳击中对手面部。

senses.en: (British, informal) an injection with a needle

example.en: He went to the clinic for a flu jab.
example.zh: 他去诊所打了流感疫苗针。

senses.en: a person who sells or arranges flowers; a shop selling flowers

example.en: I ordered a bouquet from the local florist.
example.zh: 我在当地花店订了一束花。

senses.en: higher rank or priority based on longer service
senses.zh: 资历；年资深（带来的地位）

example.en: He was promoted because of his seniority.
example.zh: 他因资历深而获得晋升。

senses.en: a violent or harmful act done against someone as punishment or revenge

example.en: The workers feared reprisals for going on strike.
example.zh: 工人们担心因罢工而遭到报复。

senses.en: a business that sells goods or services

example.en: She works for a software company.
example.zh: 她在一家软件公司工作。

senses.en: the state of being with other people

example.en: I enjoy his company.
example.zh: 我喜欢有他作伴。

senses.en: people who are visiting someone

example.en: We are expecting company for dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚餐有客人来。

senses.en: a group of actors, dancers, or musicians who work together

example.en: The theater company is touring Europe.
example.zh: 这个剧团正在欧洲巡演。

senses.en: to tell people something officially or publicly

example.en: The company announced a new policy yesterday.
example.zh: 公司昨天宣布了一项新政策。

senses.en: to introduce a person or program on radio, TV, or at an event

example.en: She announced the next guest on the radio show.
example.zh: 她在广播节目中介绍了下一位嘉宾。

senses.en: to be a sign that something is coming or present

example.en: Dark clouds announced the coming storm.
example.zh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

senses.en: the part of the body joining the head to the shoulders

example.en: She wore a thin scarf around her neck.
example.zh: 她在脖子上围了一条薄围巾。

senses.en: a narrow part of a container or garment opening

example.en: The bottle's neck was too narrow for the brush.
example.zh: 瓶口太窄，刷子伸不进去。

senses.en: to kiss and caress someone amorously

example.en: The couple were necking on the sofa.
example.zh: 那对情侣在沙发上搂抱亲吻。

senses.en: the son of your brother or sister, or of your spouse's brother or sister

example.en: My nephew stayed with us for the weekend.
example.zh: 我侄子周末和我们住在一起。

senses.en: the shared customs, beliefs, and way of life of a group of people
senses.zh: 一个群体共享的习俗、信仰和生活方式

example.en: Food is an important part of every culture.
example.zh: 食物是每种文化的重要组成部分。

senses.en: the arts, ideas, and intellectual activity valued by a society
senses.zh: 社会所重视的艺术、思想和智力活动

example.en: She studied French literature and culture at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习法国文学和文化。

senses.en: a growth of microorganisms or cells in a controlled setting
senses.zh: 在受控环境中培养的微生物或细胞

example.en: The lab examined a culture of bacteria under a microscope.
example.zh: 实验室在显微镜下检查了细菌培养物。

senses.en: to grow microorganisms or cells in a controlled medium
senses.zh: 在受控培养基中培养微生物或细胞

example.en: Scientists culture the cells in a nutrient-rich solution.
example.zh: 科学家在营养丰富的溶液中培养这些细胞。

senses.en: a feeling of happiness or enjoyment

example.en: It gave me great pleasure to see her again.
example.zh: 再次见到她让我非常高兴。

senses.en: something that gives enjoyment

example.en: Reading is one of life's simple pleasures.
example.zh: 阅读是生活中的简单乐趣之一。

senses.en: to give someone sexual pleasure

example.en: He tried to pleasure his partner.
example.zh: 他试图给伴侣带来快感。

senses.en: responsibility for a mistake or problem

example.en: It was my fault that we missed the train.
example.zh: 我们错过火车是我的过错。

senses.en: a defect or problem in something

example.en: The mechanic found a fault in the brake system.
example.zh: 机械师发现刹车系统有故障。

senses.en: to criticize or blame someone for something

example.en: She faulted him for not warning her.
example.zh: 她责怪他没有提醒她。

senses.en: a crack in the Earth's crust along which rock has moved

example.en: The map shows several active faults.
example.zh: 地图上标出了几条活动断层。

senses.en: to say what you think is true without being sure

example.en: I guess she is still at work.
example.zh: 我猜她还在上班。

senses.en: an attempt to answer or estimate without sure knowledge

example.en: My guess is that the meeting will be cancelled.
example.zh: 我猜会议会被取消。

senses.en: organized opposition to authority, especially fighting to overthrow a government

example.en: The rebellion against the government lasted three years.
example.zh: 反对政府的叛乱持续了三年。

senses.en: refusal to accept rules, authority, or conventions

example.en: Teenage rebellion is a normal part of growing up.
example.zh: 青少年的叛逆是成长过程中的正常阶段。

senses.en: a piece of equipment or furniture fixed in place in a building

example.en: The light fixture in the kitchen needs to be replaced.
example.zh: 厨房的灯具需要更换了。

senses.en: a person or thing long established in a particular place
senses.zh: （在某处长期存在、为人熟知的）老成员；固定人物/事物

example.en: The old barber has been a fixture in this neighborhood for decades.
example.zh: 这位老理发师几十年来一直是这个街区的熟面孔。

senses.en: annoyed by delays or having to wait

example.en: He got impatient waiting in the long queue.
example.zh: 排长队时他变得不耐烦了。

senses.en: eager to do something or for something to happen

example.en: She was impatient to see the results.
example.zh: 她迫不及待地想看到结果。

senses.en: having pale yellow hair

example.en: She has blond hair and blue eyes.
example.zh: 她有一头金发和一双蓝眼睛。

senses.en: a person with blond hair

example.en: The blond at the counter is my cousin.
example.zh: 柜台边的那个金发的人是我表亲。

senses.en: a pale yellow color

example.en: The wood was stained a soft blond.
example.zh: 这木头被染成了柔和的浅金黄色。

senses.en: to remove or take out something, often with effort

example.en: The dentist had to extract one of my wisdom teeth.
example.zh: 牙医不得不拔掉我的一颗智齿。

senses.en: a short passage taken from a book or document

example.en: She read an extract from her new novel at the book event.
example.zh: 她在新书活动上朗读了自己小说的一段节选。

senses.en: a concentrated substance obtained from a plant, used for flavor or medicine

example.en: This recipe calls for a teaspoon of vanilla extract.
example.zh: 这个食谱需要一茶匙香草精。

senses.en: spoken description of an event, especially a sports game, given as it happens

example.en: He works as a commentator and provides live commentary on football matches.
example.zh: 他是一名解说员，负责足球比赛的实况解说。

senses.en: a written explanation or series of comments on a text or subject

example.en: Her commentary on the new law appeared in the newspaper.
example.zh: 她对这项新法律的评论刊登在报纸上。

senses.en: a large wild cat with orange fur and black stripes, found in Asia

example.en: The tiger is hiding quietly in the tall grass.
example.zh: 老虎悄悄地藏在高草丛中。

senses.en: a fierce, brave, or determined person
senses.zh: 凶猛的人；劲头十足的人

example.en: She fought like a tiger to keep her business alive.
example.zh: 她像猛虎一样奋力保住自己的生意。

senses.en: most noticeable or important

example.en: The most salient point in her argument was the cost.
example.zh: 她论点中最突出的一点是成本问题。

senses.en: a part of a battle line or defensive position that projects toward the enemy

example.en: The troops held the salient against repeated attacks.
example.zh: 部队守住了突出部，抵御了多次进攻。

senses.en: an exercise machine with a moving belt that you walk or run on

example.en: She runs five kilometers on the treadmill every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上在跑步机上跑五公里。

senses.en: a tiring routine of work that seems endless
senses.zh: 单调乏味、无休止的工作

example.en: He left the city to escape the daily treadmill.
example.zh: 他离开城市，以摆脱日复一日的枯燥生活。

senses.en: an owner of a business or property

example.en: The proprietor of the cafe greeted every customer personally.
example.zh: 咖啡馆老板亲自迎接每一位顾客。

senses.en: to be full of or swarming with something

example.en: The river teems with fish.
example.zh: 这条河里鱼很多。

senses.en: to rain heavily

example.en: It was teeming with rain all afternoon.
example.zh: 整个下午大雨倾盆。

senses.en: to tax someone too heavily

example.en: The new policy could overtax small businesses.
example.zh: 新政策可能对小企业征税过重。

senses.en: to put too much strain on someone or something
senses.zh: 使负担过度；使过度劳累

example.en: Don't overtax yourself by working late every night.
example.zh: 不要每晚都熬夜工作，让自己负担过度。

senses.en: musical instruments played by striking, such as drums; the section playing them

example.en: She plays percussion in the school band.
example.zh: 她在学校乐队里演奏打击乐器。

senses.en: a sharp blow or the act of striking something

example.en: The engine stopped after a sharp percussion of metal parts.
example.zh: 金属部件猛烈撞击后，发动机停了下来。

senses.en: covered with a smooth shiny coating, as on pottery or food

example.en: She bought a box of glazed doughnuts.
example.zh: 她买了一盒糖浆甜甜圈。

senses.en: fitting or covered with glass

example.en: The house has double glazed windows.
example.zh: 这房子装了双层玻璃窗。

senses.en: (of eyes) dull and lacking expression

example.en: His eyes were glazed with exhaustion.
example.zh: 他疲惫得眼神呆滞。

senses.en: a close friend

example.en: He has been my chum since primary school.
example.zh: 他从小学起就是我的好友。

senses.en: chopped fish dumped in water to attract fish
senses.zh: 鱼饵碎料（用于吸引鱼群）

example.en: The fisherman threw some chum into the water.
example.zh: 渔夫往水里撒了一些鱼饵碎料。

senses.en: much too high or excessive, especially about prices or fees

example.en: The hotel charged exorbitant prices for a simple room.
example.zh: 这家酒店为一个普通房间收取了过高的价格。

senses.en: to remove offensive or improper parts from a text
senses.zh: 删改（书等中的不当内容）；删除

example.en: The publisher decided to expurgate the vulgar passages from the novel.
example.zh: 出版商决定删去小说中的粗俗段落。

senses.en: very noticeable because it attracts attention

example.en: She wore an eye-catching red dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条醒目的红裙子去参加聚会。

senses.en: people who own or work on farms

example.en: The farmers harvested the wheat before the rain came.
example.zh: 农民们在下雨前收割了小麦。

senses.en: the food eaten at one time, or the regular occasions for eating

example.en: We eat three meals a day at fixed times.
example.zh: 我们每天在固定时间吃三顿饭。
